from kohakutpu.application.api.attention import attention

def facts():
    s = (q.astype(np.float32) @ k.astype(np.float32).swapaxes(-1, -2)) * np.float32(0.125)
    e = np.exp(s-s.max(-1, keepdims=True))
    want = (e/e.sum(-1, keepdims=True)) @ vt.astype(np.float32).swapaxes(-1, -2)
    got = attention(kp.tensor(q), kp.tensor(k), kp.tensor(vt), precise_scores=True).numpy().astype(np.float32)
    rel = float(np.abs(got-want).max()/np.abs(want).max())
    print('DSL attention relative error', rel)
    return {'ok': bool(np.isfinite(got).all() and rel < 0.03)}
